fields.label: API Key
fields.description: Unscoped OPERATOR key (owa_k1_…) from the OpenWA dashboard

fields.label: Pay Link Template
fields.description: Name of the OpenWA template (Templates page, per session) used when sending a Paytm pay link. Placeholders: {{link}} {{amount}} {{valid_minutes}} {{bill_no}} {{customer_name}}, plus any field of the bill (or of the customer for a receipt) by its fieldname, e.g. {{posting_date}}. Blank or not found: the built-in message is sent.

fields.label: Invoice Template
fields.description: Name of the OpenWA template used as the caption when sending a bill from the print window. Placeholders: any field of the bill by its fieldname, e.g. {{customer_name}} {{name}} {{posting_date}} {{rounded_total}}. Blank or not found: the built-in caption is sent.
